Subject: Calyx Health — follow-up: vulnerability handover, SOC2 status, and pen test pack

Hi Emma — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and requests so we can move the security review forward: 

1) SOC 2 / compliance posture
- Can you confirm the current SOC 2 status (Type II in scope or target date)? If you have a SOC 2 summary or schedule, please share. Also note any HIPAA/GDPR considerations tied to the pilot.

2) Pen test / vulnerability artifacts
- Can you share the latest penetration test report (redacted is OK) and the internal vulnerability tracker/export (CSV preferred). We typically ask for: scope of test, vendor name, summary of critical/high findings and current remediation status, and whether fixes are backported to prod.

3) Vulnerability management process questions
- What SLA do you use for remediation at severity tiers (critical/high/medium)? What scanning cadence is in place (quarterly external, weekly internal, etc.) and who owns tracking?

4) Next steps / meeting
- It would be helpful to have one of your security contacts on a short technical sync with our security lead (Laura Bennett) and SE (Marcus). Are you available Thu 6/3 between 10–11am PT?

Upload guidance: we have a secure upload link (I can share once you confirm). If it’s easier, emailing redacted PDFs is fine for initial review.

Action requested by EOW (6/8): SOC 2 summary, redacted pen test report, vuln tracker CSV.

Thanks — I’ll loop in our security lead if you prefer a single thread for technical questions.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Pen test: We engaged SafeAudit (Nate CC’d). Attached is a redacted summary of the most recent external test (April 2027) and a current vuln tracker export. The redacted report omits internal IPs and some PoCs; we’re happy to provide more detail under an NDA if needed.

Vulnerability management: high-level answers in the tracker, but summary here — critical: 30 days SLA, high: 60 days, medium/low: triaged per release. External scans quarterly, internal weekly for CI builds, authenticated scans monthly. Owner: security@calyxhealth.com.

Known items: the April test flagged one critical issue (auth misconfig) that was patched and verified as resolved on 2027-05-14. The tracker shows a couple of medium items still in remediation (ETA 2027-06-10).

I’ve attached: calyx_pen_redacted_summary.pdf and calyx_vuln_tracker.csv. If that’s sufficient for an initial review, we can schedule the sync. Thu 6/3 10am PT works for our security lead (they prefer a short 30–45m).

Thanks,

- Redaction level looks fine at first glance but please confirm whether we want the full PoC/technical appendix under NDA.
- They state critical SLA = 30 days and external scans quarterly. Is 30 days acceptable for us to proceed, or do we need a mitigations/compensating-controls confirmation?

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Fwd: Calyx Health — follow-up: vulnerability handover, SOC2 status, and pen test pack

Thanks for forwarding — I reviewed the redacted summary and the vuln tracker CSV. Preliminary notes and asks for the sync: 

1) Scope and test details needed
- Full scope (external IPs / in-scope hosts, authenticated vs unauthenticated, internal network coverage).
- The pen test vendor is fine; we need the test plan and whether threat emulation included privileged account scenarios.

2) Findings detail
- For any critical/high items please provide CVE (if applicable), CVSS score, PoC details or exploitability note, and verification steps post-fix. The tracker should map to the full report IDs.

3) Vulnerability management processes
- Please share the policy that defines severity/SLAs, and the ticketing flow (Jira/Trello) used to track remediation. Who is the remediation owner for infra vs. application issues?

4) Remediation SLA stance
- 30 days for a critical is longer than our preferred target. If compensating controls (WAF rules, network ACLs, temporary mitigations) are in place and documented, we can accept 30 days as long as verification is provided within 7 days and rollback/mitigation steps are tracked. Without compensating controls, we would ask for a shorter remediation window (14 days) or a phased mitigation plan.

5) Scan cadence confirmation
- We’d like confirmation on both external quarterly scans and authenticated scans cadence. For any customer-facing endpoints, weekly or biweekly CI-integrated checks are ideal.

6) Meeting and artifacts
- Please request Calyx upload the full pen test appendix (under NDA if needed) and the full vuln tracker export to our secure upload link prior to the call. I’ll attach a vuln mapping template to standardize mappings (Redwood_vuln_template.xlsx).

Suggested call time: Thu 2027-06-03 10:00am PT (30–45m). Google Meet: https://meet.google.com/xyz-security-call-20270603

Action items for the call: full scope, PoC/CVE mapping for critical/high, SLA acceptance or mitigation plan, and confirmation of scan cadence.

Thanks — happy to join the call.
Laura Bennett
Senior Security Engineer | Redwood Inference
